# Ankit Pandit

> Ankit Pandit is a builder, developer, and creative technologist based in India. He specializes in turning ideas into real-world solutions through software development, hardware prototyping, and exploratory technology. His ethos centers on: "Small ideas, a brighter tomorrow. Make / Learn / Build / Repeat."
